description: This file provides date utility functions for HabitFlow, leveraging the dayjs library for date manipulations. It exports functions to get today's date, convert dates to a standardized format, generate recent date ranges, check date sequence adjacency, determine if a date falls within a range, and add days to a date.

methods.name: export function todayYYYYMMDD(): string { todayYYYYMMDD
methods.description: Returns today's date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: export function toYYYYMMDD(d: Date | string | number): string { toYYYYMMDD
methods.description: Converts a Date object, string, or number into a standardized YYYY-MM-DD string.

methods.name: export function getLastNDates(n: number): string[] { getLastNDates
methods.description: Generates an array of the last n dates, including today, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

methods.name: export function isConsecutiveDay(prev: string, next: string): boolean { isConsecutiveDay
methods.description: Checks if the 'next' date is exactly one day after the 'prev' date.

methods.name: export function inRange(day: string, start: string, end: string): boolean { inRange
methods.description: Determines whether a given day falls within the specified start and end dates, inclusive.

methods.description: Adds a specified number of days to a YYYY-MM-DD date string.
